title: Best dupe for Estee Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme?
text: Looking for more affordable options because I loved this one but not so much the price of it.

title: [Product Request] Face Lotion Recommendations?
text:
I was gifted a bottle of Estee Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme… and damn. This stuff is great. The price? Not so much. So now I’m on a mission to find a dupe for it or hopefully something at least similar. Moisturizers I’ve tried in the past have either been too light so that my skin feels tight or so heavy that I feel greasy. This moisturizer somehow is perfect. My skin feels super hydrated yet it dries so light I can barely feel I’m wearing it. It’s more like a mousse/creme than a lotion. I’m not shiny or oily and I feel like my fine lines look less noticeable. 

Unfortunately I’m not able to spend $100+ on a face lotion every few months, so I was hoping someone here might have a recommendation for something similar. It seems like a long shot but I don’t want to go back to feeling either oily or dry 😫

Thanks in advance!
